objectDescription: Report from Informer Metadata Database on Jobs Status.  This can be used in conjunction with a Job to get email alerts when a job fails or runs too long
vaultSummary: Report from Informer Metadata Database on Jobs Status.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Indicates if the job is set to run on a schedule.

fields.label: Next Run At
fields.description: The Next Run Date and Time of the Job

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: The user who owns the job

fields.label: Job History Progress
fields.description: A JSON object that holds an array of results of the job.

fields.label: Job History Success
fields.description:
Indicates if the job finished successfully
true/false Boolean field

fields.label: Job History Updated At
fields.description: Date and Time field indicating when the Job was last updated.  Usually will indicate when the job history run ended

fields.label: Heartbeat
fields.description: Date/Time field that indicates if the job is still running.  If there is a Heartbeat then it is used to calculate duration.  If there is no heartbeat duration is calculated with difference between created and updated date fields

fields.label: Job History Created At
fields.description: Date/Time that the Job History row was created.  Indicates when the Job started

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: Duration of Job run in Minutes

fields.label: Lastupdatedate
fields.description: Date/Time that this job history record was updated
